dialogues.speaker: Makhfi
dialogues.text: Sorry you had to hear me complain.

dialogues.speaker: Makhfi
dialogues.text: I was just lamenting that researchers have to deal with so many things on top of their own research.

dialogues.speaker: Makhfi
dialogues.text: Such as official Akademiya assignments, delegated tasks from mentors, getting along with peers, and sometimes, even inquiry from the matra.

dialogues.speaker: Makhfi
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only these things could just resolve themselves, like a tree shedding its leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Makhfi
dialogues.text: Now, I understand more or less why Tighnari left the Akademiya.
